Change c0284. Location: 1818 Vol. II, Ch. VII; 1831 Ch. XV.

Context before (unchanged): Here they are.

1818 text: Every thing is related in them which bears reference to my accursed origin; the whole detail of that series of disgusting circumstances which produced it is set in view; the minutest description of my odious and loathsome person is given, in language which painted your own horrors, and rendered mine ineffaceable.

1831 text: Every thing is related in them which bears reference to my accursed origin; the whole detail of that series of disgusting circumstances which produced it, is set in view; the minutest description of my odious and loathsome person is given, in language which painted your own horrors, and rendered mine indelible.

Diff: Every thing is related in them which bears reference to my accursed origin; the whole detail of that series of disgusting circumstances which produced it {+,+} is set in view; the minutest description of my odious and loathsome person is given, in language which painted your own horrors, and rendered mine [-ineffaceable-] {+indelible+} .

Context after (unchanged): I sickened as I read.

result.rationale: Substitution of 'ineffaceable' with 'indelible' keeps the same meaning (impossible to erase) in the Creature's description of Walton's pages; the added comma is punctuation only. Both words are near-synonyms, so the change is stylistic rather than interpretive.
